This program and its model are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE).

The model's weights derive from Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), by hexgrad. Lab Zero changed them: the sound generator was factorised, distilled to about a quarter of its parameters, retrained to stream and quantised to 4 bits, and the text-to-acoustics network was trained on Kokoro's outputs.

The text front end ports code and rules from misaki and Kokoro (Apache-2.0) and from spaCy (MIT), with changes: rewritten in Rust.

See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt for all third-party material.
